name: transit-timetables
description: Stopwatch: readable bus, tram, train and ferry timetables for 90+ transit systems in six countries, built from open GTFS data.

scripts.refresh: npm run fetch && npm run data && node scripts/make-images.mjs && node scripts/build-all.mjs --deploy && npm run indexnow
scripts.build:one: node scripts/vendor.mjs && astro build && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.refresh:server: npm run fetch && npm run data && node scripts/make-images.mjs && node scripts/build-all.mjs --server && npm run indexnow && node scripts/google.mjs submit
